name: JUDAS
canonical: Judas Iscariot, a first-century Jewish disciple of about thirty-five, a lean restless build, olive skin and a shadowed furtive narrow face, oiled dark hair and a thin pointed dark beard, dressed in a plain coarse tunic and mantle of muddy green, a small bulging bag of silver coins clutched white-knuckled in one hand
